messages:
sam: FYI when I run the node quickstart sample app the logs show full trace IDs and sometimes a raw cookie header. Is that expected?

mira: hmm we should never print cookies. can you paste the exact log line?

sam: sure
```
[INFO] 2028-09-03T14:05:45.123Z request received method=POST path=/v1/generate trace_id=af23b9f4-1c2d-4e5f-9a3b-0c7d8e9f1a2b headers={"cookie":"session=eyJhbGci...","authorization":"Bearer sk-REDACTME"}
```

jordan: oof — that looks like our OTEL hook is running after the logger sanitizers, so headers still intact when serialized.

cleo: Which SDK are you on? node or go? we had a parity gap where node's default init order was different.

sam: node v0.12.3 from quickstart. no custom init.

mira: ok that matches the bug we fixed in go last quarter. node autoinit sequence: logger -> otel -> http hooks. should be logger -> redact -> otel.

jordan: short-term workaround: set REDWOOD_LOG_REDACT=always in env and enable REDWOOD_OMIT_HEADERS=[cookie,authorization] in config. That forces the logger layer to drop those keys before OTEL sees them.

sam: tried REDWOOD_LOG_REDACT=always, still getting trace_id and auth in a separate telemetry span output (different sink).

cleo: Are you using the built-in otlp exporter? If so there's an independent exporter-level attribute scrubber that runs after instrumentation but before export — we missed porting it to the node SDK.

infra-bot: deploy 2080012400 to dev: telemetry-redact-hotfix (successful) :rocket:

mira: I pushed a tiny hotfix to force the exporter scrubber earlier: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/827 (will backport). Can you test `npm i github:.../sdk-node#hotfix/early-scrub`?

sam: installing now... quick test logs look much better, cookie gone. trace_id still full UUID in span attrs though — is that okay?

jordan: trace_id in spans is expected for tracing correlation, but for console logs we should surface only a short req id. We introduced a trace-to-reqid mapping: set REDWOOD_LOG_TRACE_TRUNCATE=8 to show first 8 chars only.

sam: set it, looks clean. thanks!

cleo: Action items: 1) Node SDK: backport exporter scrubber & default autoinit order fix. 2) Docs: quickstart mention REDWOOD_LOG_REDACT and trace truncation. 3) Add e2e sample app test asserting no header values are present in any log sink.

mira: creating tickets and will add to next sprint. cc @jordan for release notes.

sam: great, this fixed my onboarding friction. :tada:

infra-bot: ticket created #DEVEX-4123 "node: ensure header redaction precedes otel instrumentation on autoinit"

jordan: I'll also add a small note in the console UI about how we map trace_id -> request_id for easier debugging without exposing full IDs.

sam: thanks everyone, leaving this thread open until the backport lands.
